prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: HIGH RESOLUTION transparent game key-pose sheet. The sole reference is the APPROVED BASE SD. Preserve it absolutely: identical anatomical skull size relative to shoulders, torso, upper arm, forearm, thigh, shin and hands. NO head enlargement, NO shortening legs, NO chibi redesign. Keep exact same character face, gender, hair, eyes, outfit layers, badges, belt, gloves, boots and equipment. Change ONLY articulated pose, expression and cloth response. Every figure has exactly TWO arms originating at TWO shoulders, TWO hands, TWO legs. Each hand attached to the correct forearm, thumbs on the anatomically correct side; do not grow an additional arm holding the equipment. Avoid crossed/occluded arms: keep wrists and elbow connectivity clearly readable. The reference equipment stays in its anatomical reference hand. No invented weapons or accessories. Face SCREEN RIGHT, shallow three-quarter side view, same drawing scale and head size across cells. Preserve the reference's flat shading and dark outlines.
Requested native resolution 3072x4096 or highest available. EXACT invisible 2-column by 2-row grid. Each cell is exactly half canvas width and half canvas height, with a STRICT 15% empty transparent safety margin on ALL FOUR sides. Full figure and equipment inside cell safe area. No effects crossing cells. Place the root midpoint at cell center x, resting soles at 85% cell height; running/crouching naturally lowers height, never scale each pose to fill. NO grid lines, labels, background, shadows, glow, text, visible guides or other characters. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Restrained tiny effects only if explicitly requested. Draw one separate figure per requested cell, row-major top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Unused cells completely blank transparent.
REFERENCE2 is the exact layout stencil, NOT art style. Redraw figures strictly WITHIN its teal safe rectangles. Leave all white safety space and magenta grid-line positions TRANSPARENT in output. No guide line must remain. This includes weapons, hair, boots, extended fingers and cloth. Entire pose must fit WITHOUT growing the head or shrinking just the body. Reduce shared scale for all four cells if necessary. Anatomical right/left follow reference1 not screen directions. Exactly the same 4 invisible cell rectangles; do not rearrange rows or columns.
LIMIT EXTENSION: all fingertips, boots, cloth hems and weapons must remain within their own safe box; lower-left pointing hand must not enter lower-right cell. Tiny calm effects only, preserve TWO arms. The skull/torso ratio must match the base SD exactly; do not reinterpret as generic cartoon.
Character 이루겠네. White hair adult woman, red ribbon, red eyes, medals and gloved hands. Skill4 and overdrive are SUPPORT with reassuring open palms, not melee strike.
Cell 1: forward running stride, torso leaned toward right, one leading foot near ground, coat trailing left. Keep exactly two connected arms and hands, restrained pose, NO effect rays.
Cell 2: firm forward interception pose, braced front leg, tool or forearm raised to meet an incoming strike from the right. Keep exactly two connected arms and hands, restrained pose, NO effect rays.
Cell 3: stagger backward toward left, torso recoiling, bent knees, equipment retained, pained but alive. Keep exactly two connected arms and hands, restrained pose, NO effect rays.
Cell 4: confident forward follow-through, stable stance, tool or fist directed right, not a victory dance. Keep exactly two connected arms and hands, restrained pose, NO effect rays.
